_doc: Open-ground clearings inside otherwise wooded land. Inside each circle, a tree candidate survives with probability `keep`, and the ground raster turns bare/dusty (scripts/py/build_ground.py) over `bare` of the area. Evidence: satellite views supplied by the user show open dusty ground with groves in patches.
